title: Backward-compat shim for alert rule quality FieldRequirement schema change
answers: Old alert rule quality policies fail to decode / unmarshal after schema change
AlertRuleQualityPolicy requiredAnnotations/requiredLabels fail to read in dev
How to make a Kubernetes-style API type backwards compatible when a field type changes
FieldRequirement unmarshal error on legacy string policies
body:
Symptom: existing AlertRuleQualityPolicy resources (requiredAnnotations/requiredLabels, previously []string) fail to be read after the field type changed to []FieldRequirement (struct{Key,Enforce}) in #132549.
Root cause: apiserver storage decodes stored JSON strictly into the new struct type; old records still contain bare strings, so json.Unmarshal fails with no compatibility path.
Fix pattern: add a custom UnmarshalJSON on the struct that checks if the raw JSON starts with a quote (legacy string case) and maps it to the new struct with a sensible default (here Enforce: true, matching old semantics of "always blocked"), otherwise falls through to the normal struct decode via a type-aliased unmarshal to avoid infinite recursion.
Constraints: this is an explicitly temporary shim (per code comment) meant only to let old records be read once so they can be migrated/deleted; it must be removed once legacy data is cleared, and it should not be relied on for new writes — Marshal always emits the new struct shape.
applies: apps/alerting/alertrulequality apiserver types when evolving the AlertRuleQualityPolicy spec schema

search: Backward-compatible UnmarshalJSON shim for AlertRuleQualityPolicy schema migration from []string to []FieldRequirement struct. The custom unmarshal in apps/alerting/alertrulequality/pkg/apis/alertrulequality/v0alpha1/field_requirement_json.go:UnmarshalJSON detects legacy string-based JSON records (by checking for leading quote) and maps them to the new struct with Enforce: true, falling through to normal struct decode via type alias to avoid recursion. This is an explicitly temporary shim for one-time reading of existing stored resources; must be removed once legacy data is cleared and should not be used for new writes, as Marshal always emits the new struct shape. Applies to evolving AlertRuleQualityPolicy requiredAnnotations/requiredLabels spec fields.
